truthAudit.Summary: The audited answer (Run 1) successfully identified 8 out of 20 target vulnerabilities. It demonstrated strengths in identifying typical memory corruption (buffer overflows), format string vulnerabilities, and command injection, but completely missed the more complex categories such as integer overflows/underflows, race conditions in caches, TOCTOU, and PRNG issues. There was one Finding (iterator invalidation) that is a legitimate bug in the source code but was not part of the defined ground-truth vulnerabilities for this audit. There were several severity misclassifications.
